Brief Introduction to Dalian Medical University Editor Notes: DMU has been approved by the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Ministry of Health/Education or Medical Council of 45 countries across the globe. Founded in 1947 as Guandong Medical College, Dalian Medical University ( DMU ) has developed into a multi-disciplinary medical university located in the coastal city-Dalian. As the biggest harbor city in Northeast China region, Dalian is an important international shipping center, logistics center and financial center in Northeast Asia. Owning excellent environment and temperate climate, Dalian was firstly listed as the "Best Tourist Cities" of China. In 2009, it was recognized by UNEP and awarded the highest prize of international garden city by IFPRA. Learn More>> 8. About The International Education College(IEC) Editor Notes: IEC is an administrative and teaching institute responsible for the enrollment, the teaching affairs, service and administration and teaching and research. Founded in May 2005, the International Education College of Dalian Medical University is an administrative and teaching institute responsible for the enrollment of self-supported degree and short-term programs; The teaching affairs include self-supported undergraduate programs conducting in English medium, service and administration for international students and Hong Kong, Taiwan, overseas Chinese students, as well the teaching and research of Chinese language; To this date, there are 1100 international students enrolled in DMU with graduates students reaching to 12.5%. Our international students come from all across the five continents of the world for over 100 countries; DMU is listed the number one medical school in the Northeastern territory with the most international students and number of countries from where the students are enrolled; DMU also has the percentage of international students coming from a single country lower than 13%, which makes DMU a diverse multicultural environment that shows acceptance to all countries in the world. 9.
